response.text:
I can’t determine an exact number from that description. With ticks only at 0, 5, 10, and 15 and no data labels or source data, the chart only shows West Q3 is somewhere between $10M and $15M. A rough visual estimate might be about $12–13M (midpoint ≈ $12.5M), but that is approximate and could be off by a million or more.

If you need the exact value, please provide the underlying data (table/CSV) or the chart’s data labels/source; alternatively upload a high-resolution image of the chart so I can inspect it more precisely.
